chapters.name: Babi na 1: Lasisin da muhimman abubuwa

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Yadda lasisin dillancin kadarori yake aiki a jiharku
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Lissafa matakan jiharku na samun lasisin salesperson daga shafin hukuma.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da shafin intanet na hukuma na hukumar kadarori ta jiharku, za ku iya lissafa matakan samun lasisin salesperson bisa tsarinsu, ba tare da tsallake wani mataki ba, kuma da sunan shafin hukuma.
Babu lasisin kadarori na ƙasa baki ɗaya a Amurka. Kowace jiha tana da hukumarta, wadda ake yawan kira real estate commission ko department of real estate. Ita ce ke yanke azuzuwa, jarabawa, binciken baya da kuɗaɗe. ARELLO, ƙungiyar jami'an dokokin lasisi, tana da jerin hukumomi da za ku iya amfani da shi don nemo taku.
Matakan sun yi kama a yawancin jihohi: cika sharaɗin shekaru, gama azuzuwan kafin lasisi da jiha ta amince da su, nema, wuce binciken baya (sau da yawa da zanen yatsa), cin jarabawa, da aiki a ƙarƙashin broker mai lasisi. Jarabawowi da yawa suna da sashen ƙasa baki ɗaya da sashen dokokin jiha.
Bayanan sun bambanta sosai. California tana neman kwasa-kwasai uku na matakin jami'a (Real Estate Principles, Real Estate Practice da ɗaya na zaɓi). Texas tana neman awoyi 180 na aji a kwasa-kwasai shida, zanen yatsa da 'yan sandan jiha, da jarabawowin da kamfanin Pearson ke gudanarwa. Jiharku tana iya bambanta, don haka koyaushe ku karanta shafin jiharku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo hukumar kadarori ta jiharku (ku yi amfani da jerin ARELLO ko ku nemi sunan jiharku tare da "real estate commission" ku nemi .gov).
- Ku buɗe shafin sabon lasisin salesperson ko sales agent.
- Ku rubuta kowane mataki bisa tsari: shekaru, azuzuwa, neman lasisi, binciken baya, jarabawa, broker.
- Ku rubuta adireshin shafin da ranar da kuka duba shi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Hukumar kadarori (real estate regulator): ofishin jiha da ke ba dillalai lasisi kuma yana tabbatar da bin dokoki, kamar real estate commission.
- Salesperson (sales agent): lasisin farko na dillancin kadarori; kuna aiki a ƙarƙashin broker.
- Broker: lasisi mafi girma; broker zai iya gudanar da ofishin kadarori kuma ya kula da salespeople.
- Azuzuwan kafin lasisi (pre-license education): azuzuwan da jiha ta amince da su da dole ku gama kafin jarabawa ko lasisi.
- Broker mai ɗaukar nauyi (sponsoring broker): broker da ya yarda zai kula da ku idan kun sami lasisi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- ARELLO (Ƙungiyar jami'an dokokin lasisin kadarori): Jerin hukumomin da ke kula da lasisi
- Ma'aikatar Kadarori ta California (DRE): Sharuɗɗan lasisin salesperson
- Hukumar Kadarori ta Texas (TREC): Yadda ake zama sales agent
Gwada yanzu: Ku nemo hukumar kadarori ta jiharku. A takarda, ku lissafa kowane mataki na samun lasisin salesperson bisa tsari, tare da adireshin shafin da ranar yau. Ku zagaye duk matakin da ba ku sani ba a baya.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo hukumar kadarori ta jiharku da lissafa matakan samun lasisin salesperson bisa tsari.

check.q: Wane ne ke yanke azuzuwa da jarabawa don lasisin salesperson na kadarori?
options: Wata hukumar kadarori ta ƙasa baki ɗaya
Kamfanin kadarori da kuka shiga
Hukumar kadarori ta jiharku
Bankin da ke ba masu saye bashi
check.why: Kowace jiha ce ke ba da lasisin kadarori, kuma hukumar jihar ce ke tsara sharuɗɗan.

check.q: Wani shafi da kuka samu ya ce azuzuwan suna ɗaukar awoyi 60. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku duba awoyin a shafin hukuma na hukumar jiharku
Ku amince da shi idan yana da kyan gani
Ku biya kuɗin aji mafi araha yanzu
Ku tambayi aboki a wata jiha
check.why: Awoyin sun bambanta a kowace jiha kuma suna canjawa, don haka shafin hukuma na jiharku ne kaɗai abin amincewa.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Kalmomin kadara da mallaka da jarabawar ke amfani da su
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gane kalmar da ta dace da wata kadara ko yanayin mallaka.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku gajeren bayani game da wata kadara ko yanayin mallaka, za ku iya gane kalmar kadarori da ta dace da shi, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Real property (kadara mara motsi) ita ce ƙasa da duk abin da aka haɗa da ita, kamar gida, shinge ko bishiya, tare da haƙƙoƙin da ke tare da ita. Personal property (kayan mutum) abu ne mai motsi, kamar kujerar zama. Fixture (abin da aka kafa) a da kayan mutum ne amma yanzu an haɗa shi, kamar fanka a rufi ko injin wanke kwanoni da aka gina a ciki, don haka yawanci yana tafiya tare da gidan.
Mallakar kadara mara motsi tana nufin riƙe tarin haƙƙoƙi (bundle of rights): mallaka, amfani, jin daɗi, hana wasu, da sayarwa ko barin ta ga wani. Fee simple ita ce mallaka mafi cika. Idan mutane biyu ko fiye sun mallaka tare, joint tenancy yawanci tana da haƙƙin wanda ya rage (right of survivorship: rabon wanda ya mutu yana komawa ga sauran masu mallaka), amma tenancy in common ba ta da shi.
Deed (takardar canja mallaka) tana canja mallaka; title shi ne haƙƙin mallakar da kansa. Abubuwan da ke iyakance ko ɗora nauyi a kan kadara ana kiransu encumbrances: lien (iƙirarin kuɗi, kamar bashin gida ko harajin da ba a biya ba) da easement (haƙƙin amfani da ƙasar wani, kamar layin wutar lantarki). Ana bayyana ƙasa ta hanyoyi uku: metes and bounds, tsarin rectangular (government) survey, da lot and block daga taswirar da aka yi rajista.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Real property (kadara mara motsi): ƙasa, abin da aka haɗa da ita, da haƙƙoƙin mallaka.
- Fixture (abin da aka kafa): abin da aka haɗa da kadarar, don haka ana ɗaukarsa sashe nata.
- Fee simple: mallaka mafi cika.
- Right of survivorship (haƙƙin wanda ya rage): idan ɗaya daga cikin masu mallaka tare ya mutu, rabonsa yana komawa ga sauran.
- Encumbrance: duk abin da ke iyakance ko ɗora nauyi a kan kadara, kamar lien ko easement.
- Lien: iƙirarin kuɗi na shari'a a kan kadara.
- Easement: haƙƙin amfani da wani sashe na ƙasar wani don wani takamaiman dalili.
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi katunan tunawa 10 a takarda: kalmar a gaba, da ma'anarta da kalmominku tare da misali ɗaya a baya (real property, personal property, fixture, fee simple, joint tenancy, tenancy in common, deed, title, lien, easement). Ku gwada kanku sau biyu.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin kalmar kadarori da ta dace da yanayin kadara da mallaka da aka saba gani.

check.q: Kamfanin wutar lantarki yana da haƙƙin ratsa layi ta bayan wani gida. Wannan shi ne:
options: Fixture
Fee simple
Personal property
Easement
check.why: Easement haƙƙi ne na amfani da wani sashe na ƙasar wani don wani takamaiman dalili.

check.q: 'Yan'uwa mata biyu sun mallaki gida. Idan ɗaya ta mutu, rabonta yana komawa ga ɗayar kai tsaye. Wataƙila suna riƙe title a matsayin:
options: Tenants in common
Joint tenants
Masu haya
Masu lien
check.why: Joint tenancy yawanci tana da haƙƙin wanda ya rage; tenancy in common ba ta da shi.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Ayyukan wakili da adalci a harkar gidaje
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Zaɓi matakin da ya bi ayyukan wakili da dokar adalci a harkar gidaje a cikin wani labari.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku wani labari game da abokin hulɗa (client) ko mai neman gida, za ku iya zaɓar matakin da ya bi ayyukan wakili da dokar adalci a harkar gidaje, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, kuma kuna faɗin dokar.
Idan kuna wakiltar abokin hulɗa (client), ku ne wakilinsa (agent) kuma kuna da ayyukan amana (fiduciary duties) a kansa. Littattafai da yawa suna lissafa su da OLDCAR: Obedience (biyayya ga umarni na halal), Loyalty (aminci), Disclosure (bayyana muhimman abubuwa), Confidentiality (rufa asiri), Accounting (lissafin kuɗin da kuke riƙe) da Reasonable care (kulawa mai kyau). Dokar jiharku ce ke tsara ainihin ayyukan da fom ɗin bayyanawa.
Wakiltar mai saye da mai sayarwa a ciniki ɗaya ana kiransa dual agency. Wasu jihohi suna ba da izini ne kawai da yardar ɓangarorin biyu a rubuce, wasu kuma suna iyakancewa ko hana shi. Ku duba dokokin jiharku.
Fair Housing Act ta tarayya ta haramta nuna wariya a harkar gidaje saboda launin fata (race), launi (color), asalin ƙasa, addini, jinsi (sex), yanayin iyali (familial status, kamar samun yara) ko naƙasa. Jihohi da birane za su iya ƙara wasu rukunoni. Ayyukan da aka haramta sun haɗa da steering (karkatar da mutane zuwa ko daga wasu unguwanni saboda rukunin da aka kare), blockbusting (matsa wa masu gida su sayar ta hanyar gargaɗin cewa wani rukuni yana shigowa) da redlining (ƙin ba da bashi ko inshora a wasu unguwanni).
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku tambaya: wane ne abokin hulɗata, kuma me nake bin sa?
- Ku tambaya: shin wannan buƙata tana nuna wa wani bambanci saboda rukunin da aka kare?
- Idan haka ne, kada ku yi; ku bayyana dokar cikin ladabi.
- Ku rubuta abin da ya faru ku faɗa wa broker ɗinku.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Agent (wakili): mutumin da aka ba izinin yin aiki a madadin wani (client ko principal).
- Fiduciary (mai amana): mutumin da ke matsayin amana kuma dole ya fifita bukatun abokin hulɗa.
- Dual agency: wakili ɗaya ko ofishi ɗaya da ke wakiltar mai saye da mai sayarwa a ciniki ɗaya.
- Rukunin da aka kare (protected class): rukunin da doka ke kare shi daga wariya, kamar launin fata ko naƙasa.
- Steering: karkatar da mutane zuwa ko daga wasu unguwanni saboda rukunin da aka kare; haramun ne.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- HUD: Bayani game da Fair Housing Act (dokar adalci a harkar gidaje)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta gajerun labarai uku inda mai sayarwa ko mai saye ya nemi ku yi wani abu marar adalci (misali, "Kada ka nuna gidana ga iyalai masu yara"). Ga kowanne, ku rubuta rukunin da aka kare da abin ya shafa, da jimla ɗaya mai ladabi da za ku faɗa a maimakon haka.
Yanzu za ku iya amfani da ayyukan wakili da dokar adalci a harkar gidaje don zaɓar matakin da ya dace da abokan hulɗa.

check.q: Wani mai sayarwa ya ce, "Ka nuna gidana ga mutanen da ba su da yara kaɗai." Me za ku yi?
options: Ku bayyana cewa an kare yanayin iyali kuma dole ku nuna shi ga kowa
Ku yarda, tun da shi ne abokin hulɗarku
Ku nuna shi a ranakun aiki kaɗai
Ku tambayi masu saye yara nawa suke da su
check.why: Yanayin iyali rukuni ne da Fair Housing Act ta kare, kuma biyayya ta shafi umarni na halal ne kaɗai.

check.q: Mai sayarwarku ya faɗa muku farashi mafi ƙanƙanta da zai karɓa. Wani mai saye ya tambaye ku shi. Wane aiki ne ya shafi wannan?
options: Accounting
Confidentiality
Disclosure ga mai saye
Obedience ga mai saye
check.why: Wakili yana rufa asirin bayanan abokin hulɗarsa, kamar farashinsa mafi ƙanƙanta.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Kwangiloli, lissafi da tsarin jarabawarku

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Kwangiloli da hanyar zuwa kammala ciniki
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Duba tayin sayen gida don sassan kwangila mai inganci, kuma ku jera matakan kammala ciniki.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku samfurin tayin sayen gida, za ku iya duba cewa yana da sassan kwangila mai inganci, da jera matakan kammala ciniki bisa tsari, ba tare da wani sashe da ya ɓace ba, kuma lokutan takardun tarayya daidai.
Kwangila mai inganci tana buƙatar: ɓangarorin da doka ta ba su damar sa hannu (competent), tayi da karɓa (yarjejeniya tsakaninsu), consideration (wani abu mai daraja da kowane ɓangare ke bayarwa), da manufa ta halal. Kwangilar saye ko sayar da kadara gaba ɗaya dole ta kasance a rubuce kafin a tilasta bin ta; ana kiran wannan doka statute of frauds.
Kwangila void ce idan ba ta taɓa inganci ba (misali, manufarta haramun ce). Voidable ce idan ɓangare ɗaya zai iya soke ta, misali idan ƙaramin yaro (minor) ne ya sa hannu. Yawancin tayin saye suna da contingencies (sharuɗɗa), kamar samun bashi ko kyakkyawan sakamakon dubawa, da earnest money, ajiyar kuɗi da ke nuna cewa mai saye da gaske yake.
Hanyar da aka saba ita ce: tayi, karɓa, buɗe escrow ko wakilin kammala ciniki, dubawa (inspection), ƙimanta farashi (appraisal) da amincewa da bashi, dubawa ta ƙarshe (walk-through), sannan kammala ciniki (closing). Dokokin tarayya suna kare mai karɓar bashi: mai ba da bashi yana ba da Loan Estimate cikin kwanakin aiki uku bayan neman bashi, da Closing Disclosure aƙalla kwanakin aiki uku kafin closing, don mai saye ya kwatanta su.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku duba cewa an rubuta sunayen ɓangarorin kuma suna da damar sa hannu.
- Ku duba cewa akwai tayi a sarari da karɓa da aka sa wa hannu.
- Ku duba farashin, earnest money da abin da kowane ɓangare ke bayarwa (consideration).
- Ku duba cewa yana a rubuce kuma don manufa ta halal.
- Ku lissafa contingencies da wa'adinsu.
- Ku jera matakan closing bisa tsari, tare da lokutan Loan Estimate da Closing Disclosure.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Consideration: wani abu mai daraja da kowane ɓangare ke bayarwa, kamar kuɗi ko alƙawari.
- Statute of frauds: dokar da ke cewa kwangilolin kadarori gaba ɗaya dole su kasance a rubuce kafin a tilasta bin su.
- Void / voidable: void: ba ta taɓa zama kwangila mai inganci ba; voidable: mai inganci ce, amma ɓangare ɗaya zai iya soke ta.
- Contingency (sharaɗi): abin da dole ya faru kafin cinikin ya ci gaba, kamar amincewa da bashi.
- Earnest money: ajiyar kuɗi da mai saye ke bayarwa don nuna cewa da gaske yake.
- Closing Disclosure: fom na ƙarshe na mai ba da bashi mai sharuɗɗan bashi da kuɗaɗen kammala ciniki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CFPB: Mene ne Loan Estimate?
- CFPB: Mene ne Closing Disclosure?
- CFPB: Sayen gida (Owning a Home)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta gajeren tayin saye na ƙirƙira (sunaye, adireshi, farashi, earnest money, contingency ɗaya, sa hannu). Sannan ku duba shi da matakai shida na sama ku lissafa abin da ya ɓace. Ku gama da matakan closing bisa tsari.
Yanzu za ku iya duba tayin sayen gida don sassan kwangila mai inganci, da jera matakan zuwa closing bisa tsari.

check.q: Mai saye da mai sayarwa sun yarda kan sayar da gida ta waya kawai. A ƙarƙashin statute of frauds cinikin:
options: Ana iya tilasta bin sa gaba ɗaya
Ana iya tilasta bin sa bayan mako ɗaya
Gaba ɗaya ba a iya tilasta bin sa sai an rubuta shi
Haramun ne
check.why: Kwangilolin kadarori gaba ɗaya dole su kasance a rubuce kafin a tilasta bin su.

check.q: Yaushe mai karɓar bashi zai sami Closing Disclosure?
options: Aƙalla kwanakin aiki uku kafin closing
A ranar closing
Cikin wata ɗaya bayan closing
Kafin a yi tayi
check.why: CFPB ta ce mai ba da bashi yana ba da Closing Disclosure aƙalla kwanakin aiki uku kafin closing.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Lissafin jarabawar kadarori
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa commission, loan-to-value, harajin kadara, proration da faɗin ƙasa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku tambayar lissafi irin ta jarabawa da na'urar lissafi, za ku iya lissafa commission, loan-to-value, harajin kadara, proration da faɗin ƙasa, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, tare da nuna aikinku.
Don atisaye kawai: duk lambobin nan na ƙirƙira ne. Commission (ladan dillanci): farashin sayarwa sau kaso. Sayarwa ta $300,000 a 6% ta zama $18,000. Idan ofishin da ya saka gidan a kasuwa (listing office) ya sami rabi, wannan $9,000 ne; idan rabon wakilin (split) 60% ne, wakilin yana samun $5,400.
Loan-to-value (LTV) shi ne bashin da aka raba da ƙimar kadarar. Bashin $240,000 a kan gida na $300,000 ya zama 0.80, wato 80%. Harajin kadara shi ne assessed value (ƙimar da gwamnati ta ƙayyade) sau kason haraji: $200,000 sau 1.5% ya zama $3,000 a shekara, wato $250 a wata.
Proration tana raba kuɗi bisa kwanaki. Idan harajin shekara $3,650 ne kuma shekarar tana da kwanaki 365, wannan $10 ne a kowace rana; idan mai sayarwa ya mallaki gidan kwanaki 120 kuma mai saye ne zai biya kuɗin daga baya, mai sayarwa yana bin mai saye $1,200. Faɗin ƙasa: tsawo sau faɗi. Fili mai ƙafa 50 da ƙafa 120 yana da murabba'in ƙafa 6,000. Acre ɗaya murabba'in ƙafa 43,560 ne. Ku duba ko jarabawarku tana amfani da shekara mai kwanaki 360 ko 365.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta tambayar ku ja layi a ƙarƙashin abin da take nema.
- Ku rubuta tsarin lissafi (sashe = duka sau kaso).
- Ku mayar da kaso zuwa decimal (6% = 0.06).
- Ku yi mataki ɗaya bayan ɗaya a takarda.
- Ku tambaya: shin amsar tana da ma'ana?
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Commission (ladan dillanci): kuɗin da ake biya don sayarwa, yawanci kaso na farashin sayarwa.
- Split (raba): yadda ake raba commission tsakanin ofisoshi ko tsakanin broker da wakili.
- Loan-to-value (LTV): adadin bashi da aka raba da ƙimar kadara, a matsayin kaso.
- Assessed value: ƙimar da ƙaramar hukuma ke amfani da ita don lissafa harajin kadara.
- Proration: raba kuɗi tsakanin mai saye da mai sayarwa bisa kwanakin da kowannensu ya mallaki kadarar.
Gwada yanzu: Don atisaye kawai. Ku warware a takarda da na'urar lissafi: (1) commission na 5% a kan $250,000; (2) LTV na bashin $180,000 a kan gida na $200,000; (3) harajin shekara a kan assessed value na $150,000 a 2%; (4) rabon mai sayarwa na harajin shekara $1,825 na kwanaki 73 (shekara mai kwanaki 365); (5) murabba'in ƙafa a fili mai ƙafa 80 da ƙafa 100. Amsoshi: $12,500; 90%; $3,000; $365; 8,000.
Yanzu za ku iya warware lissafin da aka saba yi a jarabawar kadarori da nuna aikinku.

check.q: Don atisaye kawai: mene ne LTV na bashin $270,000 a kan gida na $300,000?
check.why: $270,000 da aka raba da $300,000 ya zama 0.90, wato 90%.

check.q: Don atisaye kawai: fili yana da ƙafa 100 da ƙafa 150. Murabba'in ƙafa nawa ne?
check.why: Faɗin ƙasa shi ne tsawo sau faɗi: 100 sau 150 ya zama murabba'in ƙafa 15,000.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Tsarin karatu da jarabawarku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku daga jerin abubuwan jarabawar jiharku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da jerin abubuwan jarabawar jiharku da kalanda, za ku iya rubuta tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku, wanda ya ƙunshi kowane batu a jerin, da batutuwa uku mafi rauni gare ku. Ta amfani da shafin intanet na hukuma na hukumar kadarori ta jiharku, za ku iya lissafa matakan samun lasisin salesperson bisa tsarinsu, ba tare da tsallake wani mataki ba, kuma da sunan shafin hukuma.
Jiharku ko kamfanin da ke gudanar da jarabawarta yana fitar da candidate handbook (littafin jagora ga masu jarabawa). Yawanci yana da exam content outline (jerin batutuwa da yawan tambayoyi a kowanne), dokokin ranar jarabawa, katin shaidar da dole ku zo da shi, da yadda ake tsara lokacin jarabawa. Ku sauke shi daga shafin hukuma, ba daga kwafin da wani ya saka ba.
Ku mayar da jerin zuwa tsari. Ku lissafa kowane batu, ku ba kanku maki 1 zuwa 3 a kowanne, ku yi alama a kan uku mafi rauni. Ku saka manyan ranaku a kalanda, kuna komawa baya daga ranar jarabawar da kuke so: gama azuzuwa, nema, ɗaukar zanen yatsa, tsara jarabawa. Sannan ku tsara gajerun lokutan karatu kowane mako, tare da tambayoyin atisaye da lissafi kowane mako.
Jarabawowin atisaye sun fi taimakawa idan kuna duba kowace amsar da kuka yi kuskure kuma kuna rubuta dalilin da yasa amsar daidai take daidai. Ku yi hankali da duk shafin da ke alƙawarin "tabbas za ka ci" (guaranteed pass) ko ke sayar da ainihin tambayoyin jarabawa; wannan zamba ce ko magudi, kuma jihohi za su iya hana lasisi saboda shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku sauke candidate handbook na jiharku daga shafin hukuma.
- Ku kwafi batutuwan exam content outline.
- Ku ba kanku maki 1 zuwa 3 a kowane batu; ku yi alama a kan uku mafi rauni.
- Ku zaɓi ranar jarabawa ku koma baya zuwa kowane mataki.
- Ku tsara lokutan karatu na kowane mako tare da tambayoyin atisaye da lissafi.
- Ku duba kowace amsar da kuka yi kuskure ku rubuta dalilin da yasa amsar daidai take daidai.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Candidate handbook: jagorar hukuma ta jarabawa: batutuwa, dokoki, katin shaida da tsara lokaci.
- Exam content outline: jerin batutuwan da ke cikin jarabawa da nauyin kowanne.
- Ranar da ake so (target date): ranar da kuke son rubuta jarabawa; kuna tsarawa ta komawa baya daga ita.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- ARELLO (Ƙungiyar jami'an dokokin lasisin kadarori): Jerin hukumomin da ke kula da lasisi
- Hukumar Kadarori ta Texas (TREC): Yadda ake zama sales agent
- Ma'aikatar Kadarori ta California (DRE): Sharuɗɗan lasisin salesperson
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku yi Tsarin Karatu da Jarabawar Lasisin Kadarori naku: matakan jiharku da ranaku da shafin hukuma, batutuwan jerin jarabawa tare da alamar uku mafi rauni, takardar dokoki kan wakilci, adalci a harkar gidaje da kwangiloli, tambayoyin lissafi biyar da aka warware, da jadawalin mako-mako har zuwa ranar jarabawarku.
Yanzu za ku iya mayar da jerin abubuwan jarabawar jiharku zuwa tsarin karatu da jarabawa mai ranaku da bin sa.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Matakan hukuma Wasu matakai sun ɓace, ba su bi tsari ba, ko an kwafo su daga shafin da ba na hukuma ba. An lissafa kowane mataki daga shafin hukumar jiha bisa tsari, tare da adireshin shafin da ranar da aka duba. Yana kuma rubuta kuɗaɗe da takardun kowane mataki daidai yadda shafin hukuma ya faɗa. Muhimman kalmomi Wasu kalmomin kadara ko mallaka ba daidai ba ne ko sun ɓace daga takardar dokoki. Takardar dokoki tana bayyana muhimman kalmomin kadara da mallaka daidai da kalmomi masu sauƙi. Kowace kalma tana da misali na rayuwa da mai koyo ya ƙirƙira. Wakilci da adalci a harkar gidaje Ayyukan amana ko rukunoni bakwai da tarayya ta kare sun ɓace ko ba daidai ba ne. Ya lissafa ayyukan da dukkan rukunoni bakwai na tarayya, tare da steering, blockbusting da redlining. Ya ƙara wasu rukunonin da jiha ko birnin mai koyo ya kare, tare da majiyar. Kwangila da closing Sassan kwangila ko matakan closing sun ɓace, ko lokutan Loan Estimate da Closing Disclosure ba daidai ba ne. Ya lissafa kowane sashe na kwangila mai inganci da matakan closing bisa tsari, tare da lokutan bayyanawa daidai. Ya ƙara contingencies da wa'adinsu daga samfurin tayi. Lissafi Ƙasa da 4 cikin tambayoyi 5 ne daidai, ko ba a nuna aikin ba. Aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai ne, tare da nuna aikin. Dukkan 5 daidai, tare da ƙarin tambaya ɗaya da mai koyo ya rubuta ya warware. Tsari mai ranaku Babu ranar da ake so, ko batutuwan ba daga content outline na hukuma suke ba. Ya ƙunshi kowane batu a jerin, ya yi alama a kan uku mafi rauni, kuma yana da lokutan karatu na mako-mako har zuwa ranar da ake so. Ya haɗa da ranakun duba jarabawowin atisaye da ranar jarabawa ta madadi. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake dubawa.
